guidedSteps.title: Accept the admin invite
guidedSteps.instruction: Open the app invite email sent to the admin address and set the password.

guidedSteps.title: Sign in once
guidedSteps.instruction: Open the deployed app URL and sign in once so the first login completes activation.

unsupported.name: Artifact_Intake.Detected_Objects
unsupported.detail: Text holds post-submit labels. Not a column that fills itself.
unsupported.workaround: Keep the AI-filled value out of the automatic form, or add a reviewed post-submit enrichment step before go-live.

unsupported.name: Artifact_Intake.External_Record
unsupported.detail: Needs a Connection the owner authorizes later. The column stores the external id or display text. The fetch is not generated by the schema step.
unsupported.workaround: Authorize the matching connection during migration where one exists; otherwise keep the external reference as text and complete the lookup after launch.

unsupported.name: Artifact_Intake.Extracted_Terms
unsupported.detail: Not a column that fills itself. Text stores the Zia result of a post-submit call. The call is not part of this schema step.
unsupported.workaround: Keep the AI-filled value out of the automatic form, or add a reviewed post-submit enrichment step before go-live.

unsupported.name: Artifact_Intake.Forecast
unsupported.detail: Needs a trained Zia model. No column is generated. Not-yet-tried as a generated field.
unsupported.workaround: Keep the AI-filled value out of the automatic form, or add a reviewed post-submit enrichment step before go-live.

unsupported.name: Artifact_Intake.Old_Crm_Record
unsupported.detail: Pre-Creator 5 record id (API type 23). Bigint column. The CRM connection is owner-later.
unsupported.workaround: Authorize the matching connection during migration where one exists; otherwise keep the external reference as text and complete the lookup after launch.

unsupported.name: Artifact_Intake.Old_Crm_Reference
unsupported.detail: Pre-Creator 5 display value (API type 22). Text column. The CRM connection is owner-later and is not created here.
unsupported.workaround: Authorize the matching connection during migration where one exists; otherwise keep the external reference as text and complete the lookup after launch.

unsupported.name: Artifact_Intake.Shelf_Code
unsupported.detail: Creator builds the code from static text plus other fields. The column stores that payload. The renderer is not a Data Store type. At most two per form in Creator; this step does not enforce the cap beyond reporting the field.
unsupported.workaround: Enter or paste the code value into the generated text field, or add a reviewed scanning flow if the device workflow is required.

unsupported.name: Artifact_Intake.Site_Location
unsupported.detail: Not a Creator field type. Latitude and longitude exist only inside Address (and Added/Modified Location). No geo column is invented for this token. If a source still says geolocation, it is reported unsupported.
unsupported.workaround: Capture the needed address/location in the supported address or location fields instead of a separate geo field.

unsupported.name: Artifact_Intake.Text_From_Image
unsupported.detail: Text holds a post-submit Zia OCR result. Depends on the image living in Stratus. Not self-filling.
unsupported.workaround: Keep the AI-filled value out of the automatic form, or add a reviewed post-submit enrichment step before go-live.

unsupported.name: Artifact_Intake.Tone_Result
unsupported.detail: Same as keyword extraction: text holds a post-submit Zia result. Not self-filling.
unsupported.workaround: Keep the AI-filled value out of the automatic form, or add a reviewed post-submit enrichment step before go-live.

verification: Run the guided data load, then compare each migrated table count with the source export count.
Use the per-table count report from the data step now; when c2c verify-data is available, run it to compare row counts and checksums.
Check one parent row and its related child or lookup rows before sign-off.

goLiveChecklist: Complete guided step: Accept the admin invite.
Complete guided step: Sign in once.
Load the source data and confirm every table count matches the source count.
Run record verification when c2c verify-data is available, then keep the counts/checksum report with the migration files.
Sign in as one user in each role and open the pages and reports that role should see.
Submit one test record through each converted form and confirm it appears in the expected report.
Promote the reviewed project to Production, switch business links, and keep Creator read-only until final sign-off.
